[SWS_SM_CONSTR_00031] Existence of StateMachine of type Controller
⌈
As
soon as any
StateMachine
is configured in a
Machine
exactly one
StateMachine
has to have the role of a
Controller
, at the time when the creation of the manifest is
finished.
⌋
The
Controller
is the
StateMachine
, which is automatically started, when
State
Management
starts. It is in the responsibility of
Controller
to manage the life-cyle
of:
• The whole
Machine
.
